title: Add perf as the eighth route class value
action: Per D2 (store 1593e365). In packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/verbs/state_group/workflows.rs:287-288, extend ROUTE_CLASS_VALUES from [&str; 7] to [&str; 8] by appending "perf". The arity lives in the type, so a miscount will not compile. Then update the PINNED refusal assertion at packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/verbs/state_group/tests.rs:1725 so it still matches the emitted message — update it deliberately, never delete it: a deleted assertion is proof-weakening, not a fix. Add a happy-path test beside the existing route tests asserting that --class perf is accepted and reads back as class=perf. SAFETY ARGUMENT to preserve: a lane record's `mode` field usually carries a workflow class (close.rs:395-397, uat.rs:139), and adding perf is safe only because perf is absent from ROUTE_LANE_VALUES (workflows.rs:289-290). Do not add any class value that is also a lane value.
acceptance: ROUTE_CLASS_VALUES has 8 entries ending in perf. `bee route --set --class perf --lane standard --flags "" --files 1` exits 0 and `bee route --show` reports class=perf. `--class nope` still refuses with a typed message that now lists perf. The pinned assertion at tests.rs:1725 was updated, not removed.

truths: ROUTE_CLASS_VALUES is [&str; 8] and its last entry is "perf"
bee route --set --class perf --lane standard --flags "" --files 1 exits 0, and bee route --show reports class=perf
bee route --set --class nope refuses with a typed message whose legal set now includes perf
the assertion at state_group/tests.rs:1725 still exists and was edited, not deleted
no value in ROUTE_CLASS_VALUES also appears in ROUTE_LANE_VALUES beyond the pre-existing docs and spike
